newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-PENAUD BACK FOR ENGLAND CLASH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-PENAUD BACK FOR ENGLAND CLASH.

text.p: Fly-half Alain Penaud has recovered from an ankle injury and reclaimed his place in the French squad for the Five Nations encounter at Twickenham on March 1.
Penaud, hurt playing for Brive in last month's European Cup final, replaces Dax centre Richard Dourthe who dislocated a shoulder against Wales at Parc des Princes last weekend.
Prop Franck Tournaire is also back in the 21-man squad after being suspended for one match for violent play against Ireland at Lansdowne Road.
Forwards: Christian Califano, Franck Tournaire, Jean-Louis Jordana, Marc Dal Maso, Marc de Rougemont, Olivier Merle, Hugues Miorin, Abdelatif Benazzi, Fabien Pelous, Olivier Magne, Richard Castel.
Backs: Philippe Carbonneau, Guy Accoceberry, David Aucagne, Alain Penaud, Christophe Lamaison, Stephane Glas, David Venditti, Laurent Leflamand, Hugo Mola, Jean-Luc Sadourny.
